entities.summary: Mikhail Yevgenyevich Gudkov was a Russian major general who served as Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Russian Navy from March 2025 until his death. He had previously held the position of commander of the 155th Guards Naval Infantry Brigade of the Pacific Fleet. He was killed by a Ukrainian missile strike in Kursk Oblast during the Russo-Ukrainian war.
